note: This is a redescription and measurements of Kollar's type female (given by Snyder 1924 in comparison with A. hondurensis), not an original description of a new species; the original treats only the female.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Female larger than any Anoplotermes species known from the Americas. Head dark brownish black, hairy; compound eyes large and projecting; mandibles long; distance between ocelli and compound eyes nearly equal to their long diameter; fontanelle a small yellow swelling; postclypeus dark brown, raised, about 1/3 as long as wide; pronotum paler than the head; hind tibia yellowish brown, elongate.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Female: head dark brownish black, hairy; compound eyes large and projecting; mandibles long; distance between ocelli and compound eyes nearly equal to the ocellus long diameter; fontanelle a small yellow swelling; postclypeus dark brown, raised, about 1/3 as long as wide; pronotum paler than the head; hind tibia yellowish brown, elongate. Measurements (female): alate body length 14.5+ mm; dealate body length 5.5+ mm; head length 1.35 mm, head width 1.3 mm; pronotum length 0.65 mm, width 1.15 mm; left mandible length 0.65—0.70 mm; hind tibia length 1.4 mm; forewing length 13 mm, width 3.2 mm; eye diameter 0.35 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Ypanema, Sao Paulo, Brazil; type female Type No. 422 (M. C. Z.). Snyder 1924 gave the above description and measurements from the type specimen, for comparison with A. hondurensis, A. fumosus and A. ater.
